docs.title: IntellectScout Trading Bot
docs.text: Welcome to the IntellectScout Trading Bot documentation!

docs.title: Overview
docs.text:
IntellectScout is a production-ready automated trading bot that enables users to:

  • Automated Trading: Execute trading strategies automatically using Alpaca API
  • Real-time Monitoring: Track positions, performance, and bot status in real-time
  • User Management: Secure authentication with email verification and role-based access
  • Strategy Management: Create, configure, and manage multiple trading strategies
  • Risk Management: Built-in risk controls and position management

docs.title: 🔐 Security
docs.text:
• Encrypted credential storage
  • Email verification
  • Role-based access control (Trader, Admin, Owner)
  • Secure session management

docs.title: 📊 Trading
docs.text:
• Paper and live trading modes
  • Multiple strategy support
  • Real-time position tracking
  • Portfolio performance analytics

docs.title: 🛠️ Developer Experience
docs.text:
• Comprehensive test coverage
  • Code quality tools (Ruff, mypy, bandit)
  • Pre-commit hooks
  • CI/CD pipeline

docs.title: Architecture
docs.text:
The trading bot consists of:

  • Backend: Flask-based REST API with WebSocket support
  • Frontend: React application with real-time updates
  • Database: PostgreSQL (production) / SQLite (development)
  • Trading Engine: Alpaca API integration

docs.title: Configuration
docs.text: This guide covers all configuration options for the IntellectScout Trading Bot.

docs.title: Required Variables
docs.text:
# Secret key for Flask sessions (generate with: python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(32))")
SECRET_KEY=your-secret-key-here

# Encryption key for storing Alpaca credentials (generate with: python -c "from src.utils.encryption import generate_encryption_key; print(generate_encryption_key())")
ENCRYPTION_KEY=your-encryption-key-here

# Database URL
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI=postgresql://user:password@localhost/trading_bot
# Or for SQLite: sqlite:///trading_bot.db

docs.title: Email Configuration
docs.text:
# Resend API key for sending emails
RESEND_API_KEY=your-resend-api-key

# Email sender address
EMAIL_FROM=noreply@intellectscout.com

# Application URL (for email links)
APP_URL=https://intellectscout.com

docs.title: Trading Configuration
docs.text:
# Default trading symbols (comma-separated)
DEFAULT_TRADING_SYMBOLS=AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL

# Default strategy symbols
DEFAULT_STRATEGY_SYMBOLS=AAPL,MSFT,GOOGL

docs.title: Server Configuration
docs.text:
# Flask port
FLASK_RUN_PORT=5002

# Frontend port
VITE_PORT=5173

# Flask environment
FLASK_ENV=development  # or production

docs.title: Backend Configuration
docs.text: Configuration is managed through: - src/config/constants.py - Application constants - src/config/development.py - Development settings - src/config/staging.py - Staging settings - src/config/production.py - Production settings

docs.title: Frontend Configuration
docs.text: Frontend configuration uses Vite environment variables: - VITE_API_URL - Backend API URL (set at build time)

docs.title: Security Best Practices
docs.text:
1. Never commit .env files - They contain sensitive credentials
  2. Use strong secret keys - Generate unique keys for each environment
  3. Rotate encryption keys - If compromised, users must re-enter credentials
  4. Use HTTPS in production - Always use SSL/TLS for production deployments

docs.title: Development
docs.text:
FLASK_ENV=development
DEBUG=True
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI=sqlite:///dev.db

docs.title: Staging
docs.text:
FLASK_ENV=staging
DEBUG=False
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI=postgresql://user:pass@staging-db/trading_bot

docs.title: Production
docs.text:
FLASK_ENV=production
DEBUG=False
SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI=postgresql://user:pass@prod-db/trading_bot
ALLOWED_ORIGINS=https://intellectscout.com

docs.title: Installation
docs.text: This guide will help you install and set up the IntellectScout Trading Bot.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
• Python 3.10 or higher
  • Node.js 18+ and npm
  • PostgreSQL (for production) or SQLite (for development)
  • Alpaca API account (paper or live trading)

docs.title: Backend Installation
docs.text:
1. Clone the repository: 

    git clone https://github.com/betintellect-com/trading_bot.git
cd trading_bot

  2. Create a virtual environment: 

    python3 -m venv venv
source venv/bin/activate  # On Windows: venv\Scripts\activate

  3. Install dependencies: 

    pip install -r requirements.txt

  4. Set up environment variables: 

    cp .env.example .env
# Edit .env with your configuration

  5. Initialize the database: 

    python scripts/migrate_db.py

docs.title: Frontend Installation
docs.text:
1. Navigate to frontend directory: 

    cd src/frontend

  2. Install dependencies: 

    npm install

  3. Set up environment variables: 

    # Create .env file
echo "VITE_API_URL=http://localhost:5002" > .env

docs.title: Development Mode
docs.text:
Backend: 

python run.py
# Or use the isbot script
isbot start

Frontend: 

cd src/frontend
npm run dev

docs.title: Production Mode
docs.text: See the Production Deployment guide.

docs.title: Verification
docs.text:
1. Open http://localhost:5173 in your browser
  2. Register a new account
  3. Verify your email (check console for token in development)
  4. Log in and configure your Alpaca credentials
